studies.study_title: Prognosis of cancers associated with venous thromboembolism

It is NOT a randomised controlled trial. studies.study_title: A modified Khorana risk assessment score for venous thromboembolism in cancer patients receiving chemotherapy: the Protecht score
studies.predicted_reason: This study describes the development of a modified Khorana risk assessment score (the Protecht score) for predicting VTE risk in cancer patients receiving chemotherapy. While the topic is related to VTE in cancer patients on chemotherapy, this paper is about risk score development/validation, NOT a randomised controlled trial comparing anticoagulant interventions. Although it references the PROTECT study (NCT 00951574) which tested nadroparin prophylaxis, this publication itself does not present RCT data comparing anticoagulants. It fails to meet the selection criteria requiring RCTs comparing anticoagulants or prophylaxis interventions.
